items.text: [p align="justify"]Hello shoppers!

notes.title: We are incredibly excited to announce that Storebound will be launching its full 1.0 version this summer!

items.text: [p align="justify"]Reaching 1.0 is a massive milestone for us, and it means the complete story arc of the Megastore will finally be yours to uncover. But we aren’t just adding the final chapters; we’ve spent the last 10 months listening to you to ensure the definitive version of the game is as close as possible to what the community has been asking for.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464207/b2cda96fa3168fff89557800016f407d84540f7a.png"]

notes.title: New QoL Patch: Live Right Now!

items.text: [p align="justify"]We are still closely monitoring every review on Steam and every message in our Discord. We are releasing a Quality of Life patch today that addresses some of your most recurring requests.
Field of View (FOV) Slider: You can now freely adjust your field of view settings to improve gameplay comfort.
Graphic Filters Toggle: Added the ability to turn the stylized visual filters on or off in the options menu.
More Mid-Episode Checkpoints: Implemented additional checkpoints throughout all episodes, in case your squad gets wiped out.
Unstuck Button: There is now an "Unstuck" button in the menu. If you get stuck somewhere, you can still report it to us so we can fix it but please use this button so you can continue playing!
More bug fixing.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464207/ac2d3c20ed991ddbfee1734b7364977889c32986.png"]

[p align="justify"]Episodes 5 and 6 will bring the Storebound saga to its conclusion. However, the vibe is shifting. While Episodes 1 through 4 saw you playing as lost shoppers and teenagers just trying to get out, the final act puts you in a different pair of shoes.
[p align="justify"]You won’t be "lost" this time, you're going in with a purpose. But in a place like the PRESENT megastore, having a plan might just make you a bigger target.
[p align="justify"]Episode 6 will be longer than the other episodes, and it will serve as a chaotic grand finale!

notes.title: Watch the 1.0 Teaser Trailer below for a first look at the mission ahead

items.text: We’ll have more news on the specific release date and playtest very soon. In the meantime, jump into the new patch, and let us know what you think!
Nikko
Community Manager @Embers
Hello shoppers!
We hope you are enjoying your time shopping at Present with Episodes 3 and 4. If you had a pleasant experience, please leave us a review! You can do that on the main store page below.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417410/Storebound/"]It's been about a week since we added Episodes 3 and 4. We just put a patch live addressing issues that were reported by players.

notes.title: Here is a list of fixes

items.text: When Episodes 3 and 4 launched, we changed our networking to be handled via Steam instead. If you were have networking issues (especially players in regions like Russia or China), please try again and let us know if things are improved.
Fixed a bug causing some random disconnection after using a checkpoint and some cases that caused the players to be unable to move or look around.
Fixed inconsistent notes in the office section in Episode 4. If the puzzle seemed like it did not have the correct answer, try it out again!
Fixed texts in the office puzzle for several languages including: Russian, Ukrainian, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
Fixed the serial reader achievement in episode 3 that couldn't be completed even when all notes were collected.
Fixed a soft lock possible at the end of Episode 2.
Fixed an infinite falling screen if a player died inside a sky tile. Whoops.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464207/c4682164045bd1ed0d2bdf8e9b551ec9f1d8004e.png"]We are still on the look out for more issues, so please report them here or in our Discord!
That's all for now, see you in the aisles!
Nikko
Community Manager @ Embers
Hello shoppers!
A new patch is live that hopes to address networking issues some players are having.

Microphone & Voice Chat: We have added in a fix that should address this for players who were experiencing voice chat issues. This issue would occur when you could not hear your teammates or they could not hear you despite microphone settings being correct.

Joining and Hosting Lobbies: Some players were experiencing an issue where they could not join or host lobbies. Sometimes an error would occur that would state: "The match you are trying to join is running an incompatible version of the game." We have added a fix so players who were running into the issue should be able to join and host lobbies correctly now.
If you are still having any networking issues after the patch, here is a list of things to check:
Check Antivirus and/or Windows Defender and make sure to whitelist the game.
Be sure to run the game .exe as administrator.
Check the no other program is using port 7777.
Disable your VPN (we notice this can be an issue for some players in non-US countries).

If our patch today did not fix your networking issues and none of the above did either, please let us know so we can work on a fix for you ASAP! You can leave a comment here, in the Steam discussions board, or join the Discord and report them to us directly there!
We know networking issues can hamper the shopping experience, so we'll continue to monitor and work to resolve any issues that your report!
Nikko
Community Manager @Embers

While we’re deep into development on Episodes 3 & 4, we’re also actively monitoring your feedback on Steam and Discord to keep improving the game. This update focuses on stability fixes and resolving several progression blockers reported by players.
Fixed an issue in Episode 1 where TVs would sometimes fail to display the backshop after completing the puzzle.
Fixed a potential soft lock in Episode 2 during the end sequence.
Fixed a potential soft lock in Episode 2 at the start of the episode.
Fixed a potential lock when multiple players tried to enter the same vent simultaneously.
Fixed a progression lock that could occur when playing solo in the maze.
Fixed a soft lock if a player was standing behind a door as it opened.
Fixed animation issues when picking up and dropping items.
Fixed an issue causing powers to behave incorrectly when dropped multiple times in the hub.
Fixed a death effect that could remain visible even after being revived.
Fixed an issue where enemies sometimes were unable to move.
Fixed various translation typos.
Fixed crashes that could occur when trying to find servers.

Mic or Voice Chat issues - while we are still investigating this problem, we noticed some players had issues while using a VPN or a software like Ban. If you are playing with a VPN or similar software active, try deactivating it, as it may block your microphone or other players'. Be sure to check your input device in the settings in the game as well.

Thanks again for all your reports — they’re incredibly helpful as we build the next episodes and continue to polish Storebound. As indicated in our roadmap, we're working towards having Steam achievements unlockable in a new patch next month, so stay tuned!
The Embers team

releases.displayName: Storebound First EA Patch is live!

items.text: Our first patch to Storebound is live now! Thank you to everyone who reported bugs and provided feedback. Seeing everyone experience the game has been amazing, but we also know some issues were found while playing. This is our first patch to fix both bugs and some gameplay moments.
We'll continue to patch the game with fixes and we'll be back soon with a roadmap going over future content and episodes that will be added to Storebound!
Episode 1
Finding the Back Shop has been made easier.
The TV puzzle at the start of Episode 1 has been improved.
The number of TVs in the puzzle has been reduced from 5 to 3.
The images on the TV screens were made clearer to avoid confusion.
While playing alone in single player, the remotes are now with the TVs
Episode 2
The Fake Outdoor area has been improved.
The number of TVs to check has been reducded from 10 TVs to 7.
Two houses have been removed from the area to make navigating the zone easier.
The Mall Area before the CUTS shop has been improved.
Additional fuses will be guaranteed to spawn in the area.
Two more circuit breakers have been added to the area.
More lighting queues and signs have been added to improve guidance through the zone.
A carboard ramp has been added to create a one way shortcut around the shopping cart puzzle.
Fixed an issue where players couldn't change the voice volume of other players.
Fixed an issue causing an infinite black screen after loading a scenario.
Fixed a bug where some players couldn’t drop items from their hands.
Fixed various enemy pathfinding problems.
Fixed items falling under cables and becoming unreachable. This occurred often when attempting to build a door during the final section of Episode 1.
Fixed several UI display glitches.
The game will no longer crash during the transition between the main menu and the game.
Many minor audio issues have been fixed.
While respawning, players will no longer spawn on incorrect spawn points.
Fixed key-rebinding issues that prevented certain actions from being remapped.
Fixed a soft-lock at the end of Episode 2.
Fixed a potential soft-lock when playing Episode 2 solo.
Some players are experiencing problems with in-game voice chat. We did some improvements here but a few niche crashes remain. We’re actively tracking and fixing them.
